projection.about: Local oblique ground mapping, scan px <- metres: u = origin_u + px_per_m_x*X + depth_px_per_m[0]*D, v = origin_v + depth_px_per_m[1]*D - px_per_m_height*H. X runs along the street (right = out of the city), D is depth (away from the viewer, i.e. north), H is height. Fitted on the moat bridge: near-left deck corner (8275,1565) is the origin; far-left corner at (8505,1135), assuming the deck is 8 m wide and the bridge 14 m long. Heights use the same scale as X, so painted figures (165-190 px) read about 1.3x life size, a painting convention; the build uses true-scale people.

figures.note: Outside the tax office, in a long robe, receiving the manifest from a carter (余辉: the inspector naming a large figure; museum: owner and official arguing). Faces right toward the carters, slightly toward the viewer.
Seated behind the desk in the three-bay tax office, about to write the declaration; faces the street. Feet hidden under the desk, so the foot point is estimated.
Driver of the camel caravan's tail inside the gate, holding the lead rope; faces right toward the camels, which are walking out through the gate.

The lone figure in the tower's doorway. 余辉 and the museum: a watchman looking down at the tax-office quarrel; Hansen: a sightseer gazing into the city. Either way he looks toward the city side. Lower body hidden by the threshold; the 10 m floor height is assumed, not measured. Painted at about half the size of the street figures.
Porter with two baskets on a shoulder pole, walking across the moat bridge toward the gate (into the city).

Sightseer in a blue robe leaning on the near railing with folded arms, watching the water (邵琦: people at the railing watching fish); head turned right. Legs hidden behind the railing, so the foot point is estimated.
The carter in the brown robe at the bales, handing the manifest to the inspector (余辉: the second carter hands him the manifest and a brush). Back half-turned to the viewer.
Inside the tax office, leaning over the desk toward the official to declare the goods (余辉: one carter goes inside to declare). Feet hidden by the desk; foot point estimated.
Outside the gate, a man in white half-reclining against the foot of the wall, dozing (邵琦: 城墙下有人靠着城墙休息).
Idler in a white jacket and trousers, standing in the group by the wall, hands in sleeves, talking.
Man in a knee-length blue robe and white trousers at the front of the group, looking out toward the road.
Man in grey behind the group, turned toward the others.
Man in white at the wall end of the group, holding a stick.
Man in brown squatting at the right of the group.
Man in white leaning on the near railing of the moat bridge with folded arms, watching the water (邵琦: 观鱼). Legs hidden behind the railing; foot point estimated like bridge_sightseer's.
Man in a blue robe leaning on the near railing, chin on his hands.
Man in white leaning on the near railing beside the man in blue.

unresolved.note: The barber at the wall foot (城下修面, x 7650-7810 per sections.md) could not be identified: the silk is too faded there, and the restyle painted a different group of standing men. Needs a better scan (the Palace Museum viewer) before placing.
